svg.title: FIFO boundaries and interrupt handling
svg.desc: Directed simulation VCD · bus vectors are hexadecimal. Values and timing are derived from the directed simulation VCD.
svg.text: Directed simulation VCD · bus vectors are hexadecimal
A rejected TXDATA write asserts PSLVERR and raises an enabled interrupt
A write-one-to-clear access to IRQ_STATUS deasserts IRQ
RXDATA returns oldest word 0x00000023 as SPI completion queues a new word · RX level 3 → 3
